Implementation notes for the coding AI

  • Inspect the existing hero component and adapt this composition to the current app. Do not replace unrelated dashboard content.
  • Use a high-quality, locally stored image asset. Do not redraw the photographic scene with SVG or CSS.
  • Keep the image vivid on the right. Apply a left-side fade only near the text; do not fade the whole image or start the transition at the centre.
  • Keep the welcome hero in normal page flow so it scrolls away. Navigation may remain accessible independently.
  • Motion is optional and should be subtle. Do not add a crude animated helix on top of the photograph.
  • Preserve existing text and interactions unless the product owner explicitly approves copy changes. The copy above is illustrative.
  • Check desktop and mobile rendering, text contrast, reduced-motion behaviour, and production build.

This file embeds the generated visual reference, so it works offline as a single HTML file.
